name: rebuilt-sections
title: Rebuilt Sections
description: Custom-built marketing sections for navigation, authentication, and pricing decisions.
useWhen: You need a clear marketing section that leads visitors toward one understandable next step.
avoidWhen: The section requires product-specific business logic that belongs in the consuming app.
responsiveBehavior: Sections collapse into a single readable column while preserving action prominence and content order.
accessibility: Navigation uses landmarks and visible focus states.
Forms and pricing actions retain meaningful labels and heading hierarchy.

variants.title: Agent Workspace hero
variants.description: A product-facing hero section with a strong headline, supporting copy, two clear actions, and a visual plan surface that explains the registry-first workflow.
accessibility: Keep the heading structure intact and ensure both call-to-action links have descriptive labels.

variants.title: Agent Workspace trust strip
variants.description: A proof-oriented section with three concise trust cards that explain the value of a registry-first UI workflow without relying on fake logo content.
accessibility: Maintain a clear section heading and preserve readable contrast for all supporting copy.

variants.title: Agent Workspace workflow
variants.description: A darker three-step workflow section that explains how agents move from registry search to composition to reusable refinement.
accessibility: Preserve a meaningful section heading and keep step labels visible as text, not color alone.

variants.title: Agent Workspace pricing
variants.description: A cleaner three-plan pricing section with one emphasized recommended plan and simpler benefit groups for SaaS evaluation.
accessibility: Plan differences remain visible in text and structure, not color alone.

variants.title: Agent Workspace closing CTA
variants.description: A restrained end-of-page call to action that leads visitors back into the component library without competing with the global site footer.
accessibility: Use descriptive link labels and keep the section heading meaningful in the page outline.

variants.title: Navigation
variants.description: A restrained marketing navigation with one clear primary action and a compact responsive rhythm.
accessibility: Use a navigation landmark and a labelled menu toggle on small screens.

variants.title: Authentication layout
variants.description: A focused sign-in frame that gives the form priority while keeping supporting context quiet.
accessibility: Associate labels and errors with their controls and keep the submit action explicit.

variants.title: Pricing
variants.description: A comparison section with one emphasized plan, short benefit groups, and an obvious decision path.
accessibility: Do not communicate plan differences with color alone; retain visible names and values.
